title: Kyoto — The Imperial City in Three Acts

days.title: Arrival & Secret-Garden Sanctuary
days.name: Check-in at Aman Kyoto
days.description: Arrive and settle into Aman Kyoto, a minimalist sanctuary hidden within a secret garden forest with onsen baths and absolute quiet. The afternoon is left open for forest bathing and a slow first evening, easing into the city's rhythm.

days.title: Tea, Temples & a Three-Star Table
days.name: Private Tea Ceremony & Kikunoi Kaiseki
days.description: Morning opens with a private Chanoyu ceremony led by a 15th-generation tea master in a historic Urasenke tearoom. The evening closes at Kikunoi Honten, Yoshihiro Murata's three-star kaiseki temple, for a seasonal course reflecting the 72 microseasons.

days.title: An Invitation-Only Evening in Gion
days.name: Geisha Evening in Gion
days.description: The final night is an invitation-only evening in a historic ochaya teahouse, with a private geiko and maiko performance rarely open to visitors. Dinner beforehand is a refined Kyo-ryori course, leaving the night for conversation, music, and ceremony.
